intent: Product chrome at every width. Wide (>= --grid-breakpoint-md, 64rem): AppHeader over SideNav + content (layout-shell / layout-app, radius none, no gap, SideNav showHeader false). Narrow: SideNav hidden; a Menu Button at the start of AppHeader opens the same nav in a left Drawer.

header.note: AppHeader props except radius (always none). On narrow screens the Menu Button takes the logo slot, so the mark or logo shows only when wide.

nav.note: SideNav props except showHeader, radius, and side: title, mark, groups or items, footer, open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange for the wide rail. The Drawer shows the same data, always expanded, titled nav.title.

children.note: Page content: a layout-canvas or layout-workspace, or another pattern. Pages own their one primary Button.

className.note: Extra class on the layout-shell root, e.g. to give it the viewport height.

responsive.breakpoint: --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem). matchMedia reads the token at runtime; the CSS module repeats 64rem only for the first paint before hydration.
narrow: No SideNav in the layout; content takes the full width
Menu Button (tertiary sm, lucide Menu, ariaLabel "Open navigation") sits in AppHeader's start column
Left Drawer size sm holds SideNav showHeader false, always expanded
Picking a leaf, Escape, or a scrim click closes the Drawer; focus returns to the Menu Button
AppHeader search stays an Input; below 38rem AppHeader already stacks it under the brand row
Widening past the breakpoint closes the Drawer and brings SideNav back without a reload

requirements: Menu Button is a kit Button with ariaLabel "Open navigation"
The Drawer is the kit dialog: aria-modal, focus trapped, Escape and scrim close, focus restored to the trigger
Parent nav items (disclosures) do not close the Drawer; leaves do
Active leaf keeps aria-current=page in both SideNav and the Drawer

doNot: Do not invent MobileNav, HamburgerMenu, BottomNav, TabBar, or a bottom tab bar
Do not make SideNav itself an overlay (position:fixed, its own scrim, focus trap); on narrow screens it renders inside kit Drawer
Do not add a local scrim, sheet, or fixed aside; kit Drawer is the only overlay
Do not put the menu trigger outside AppHeader or in a local header cousin; it lives at the start of AppHeader
Do not keep a fixed SideNav or a collapsed rail below the breakpoint
Do not read var() inside a media query; use 64rem with a comment naming --grid-breakpoint-md, or matchMedia reading the token
Do not put a primary Button in the shell; pages own theirs
Do not invent a padded app shell. Product chrome is layout-shell (AppHeader, radius none) over layout-app (SideNav, radius none, showHeader false). No gap between header and nav.
